title: Hearty Dutch Vegetables Braise
description: A hearty, comforting Dutch braise made with a variety of fresh vegetables, served with a creamy almond milk sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are softened, about 8 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots, celery, and potatoes, and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they are tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the thyme sprigs and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Pour in the almond milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the braise cook, covered, for 25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season the braise with the salt-free seasoning blend and serve hot.
Serve the braise over mashed potatoes or egg noodles, if desired.
